UserBearer.description: Per-device API token belonging to one user. Carries every right the owning user has — data plane, project CRUD, membership, metrics. Created from the dashboard's API Tokens page; the plaintext is shown once.

info.description:
Tiered memory service with hybrid search (keyword + vector + graph), per-user isolation, and project-scoped sub-brains.

**Auth**: every authenticated route accepts either an `nm_…` user bearer (created from the dashboard's API Tokens page) or a Better Auth session cookie/bearer (set by `POST /api/auth/sign-in/email`). Both flow through the same auth hook and resolve to the same user. Better Auth's own routes are mounted at `/api/auth/*` — see the Better Auth documentation for their shapes.
info.title: novamem

get.description:
Discovery document the MCP authorization flow starts from: an unauthenticated request to a protected route answers 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="…"` pointing here. Public — discovery has to work before the caller holds a credential.

novamem is an OAuth 2.1 *resource* server in shape but not in issuance: it mints its own `nm_…` bearers from the dashboard rather than delegating to an authorization server, so `authorization_servers` is deliberately absent. Naming one that cannot issue tokens for this resource would send clients into a flow that dead-ends.

delete.description: Single-endpoint MCP transport serving both protocol eras (ADR 0006). Modern (2026-07-28): stateless — every POST declares its version in `params._meta` and mirrors `Mcp-Method` (plus `Mcp-Name` on `tools/call`) into headers, which are validated against the body; `server/discover` reports the supported versions. No session is minted or echoed. Legacy (2025-11-25 and earlier): `initialize` returns a session id in the `Mcp-Session-Id` response header which must be echoed on subsequent calls; GET opens a server→client SSE channel and DELETE closes the session. Origin and MCP-Protocol-Version are validated on every request; an unsupported version answers -32022 with the list to retry from.
